root_cause.text: In the ALSA fireworks driver, the `efw_transaction` function performs an out-of-bounds array access on `efr_status_names` because it uses a raw 32-bit device-supplied status value as an index without validating it against the array size.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description notes that `efr_status_names[]` has only 17 entries while the status field is a 32-bit value that can exceed this range (e.g., `0x80000000`), and the patch diff replaces the direct array access `efr_status_names[be32_to_cpu(header->status)]` with a conditional check `st < ARRAY_SIZE(efr_status_names)` to ensure safe indexing.
